title: The Donelson Destination
description:
A charming ranch-style home nestled on a lush acre lot in the historic Bluefield neighborhood. Enjoy the tranquility of the fully treed surroundings, while still having easy access to various restaurants and shopping options. Experience the best of both worlds…the city's attractions within reach and a cozy haven to retreat to at the end of each day.  Unwind in the expansive outdoor area, perfect for relaxation after a day of city exploration.

The space
This 3 bedroom 2 bath, 3000 square foot home on a fully treed 1-acre lot is the perfect place to relax when you aren't out on the town.  The dining room has a table that seats 10, great for game night in!  Fully equipped kitchen with everything a chef would want.  Great outdoor fireplace, lots of seating, and a table for enjoying what you cooked on the grill!

Guest access
3 Bedrooms, large living room, separate den, full kitchen with all amenities, 2 bathrooms, large dining room, beautiful outdoor patio, and fireplace with grill.

Other things to note
If smoke is detected in the house there will be a $500 fee charged.

Only the guests that are registered for the stay are allowed on property unless prior approval by host.
